description:
Kling V2.6 video generation with sound and voice support.

Modes determined by inputs:
- Text-to-video: prompt only
- Image-to-video: prompt + image (first frame)
- Start/end frame: prompt + image + end_image
- Voice control: prompt + image + voice_id

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video content. For voice control, include @voice_name where the character speaks. Max 2500 chars.
examples: Ocean waves crashing on rocky shore at golden hour
prompt.title: Prompt

image.description: Start frame image for image-to-video. Formats: jpg, jpeg, png. Max 10MB, min 300px.
image.title: Image

end_image.description: End frame image. Requires image to be set.
end_image.title: End Image

voice_id.description: Voice ID for voice-driven animation. Use @voice_name in prompt to mark speech.
voice_id.title: Voice Id

title: AppInput
